checks.name: logic_errors_explicitly_corrected
checks.value: R34 longer ribbons do not prove that the remaining separated-family reading can be solved by higher risers or by globally inflating the mask. Support strength and support topology are different variables: a stronger island remains an island. Conversely, unrestricted morphological closing would erase meaningful drainage interruptions. R35 therefore tests only short contour-tangent bridges with inherited stair-frame compatibility and keeps every <=12 m drainage core untouched.
checks.limit: reject higher-riser/global-inflation and unrestricted closing shortcuts

checks.name: real_world_constraint_is_explicit
checks.value: real terrace branch/merge locations cannot be reconstructed quickly from the current 12.5 m macro DEM and photographs. The selected-field microtopography, surveyed riser/bund/channel sections, management boundaries, inlet/outlet sill elevations and event water-management records needed to distinguish a farmed join from a drainage break are absent. R35 bridges are synthetic morphology candidates, not measured Yunnan terrace junctions.
checks.limit: state missing real-world evidence that blocks fast reconstruction

checks.name: xiaoma_truth_boundary_retained
checks.value: the Xiaoma/TLO intake still records field location/boundary, field microtopography, bund section, channel section and water-control elevation as unknown. A visually continuous bench does not establish ownership, hydraulic connectivity, head, water depth or discharge. R35 creates none of those states.

checks.name: mrrolord_ordering_only
checks.value: the saved MrRolord frame audit is used for ordering only: drainage hierarchy -> accumulated terrain influence -> terrain-conforming contour land use. R35 keeps hydrology-first hard exclusions and adds only deterministic world-space contour-tangent morphology; it does not copy Blender dimensions, Voronoi cells, shader displacement or adaptive subdivision as agricultural truth.

checks.name: user_reference_reopened_without_metric_inference
checks.value: image(173).png was reopened this round. R35 uses only the visible morphology that long contour-following benches can locally reconnect and nest while narrow drainage interruptions remain legible.
